visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three monks in maroon robes are centered; the middle one performs a ritual sprinkling with a whisk while the others assist. The monks' faces are focused and serene. The scene is filled with gold cylindrical objects adorned with red slips, stacked on ornate gold racks. The room is brightly lit with white curtains in the background. A pink and white text box is visible in the upper right. (2) A sequence of close-up shots pans across the ritual objects, highlighting the metallic gold texture of the cylinders and the red paper labels with black ink characters. The lighting creates a high-contrast sheen on the gold surfaces. In the background, a street view is partially visible through a window. The text overlay remains in the upper right corner. (3) The monks are outdoors on a grey tiled pavement, standing next to a large rectangular metal burner. They methodically drop the wealth buckets into rising orange and yellow flames. Their movements are deliberate and rhythmic. A small red gas canister and potted plants are visible in the background. (4) The scene shifts to a full-screen graphic display with white and peach backgrounds. It features photographs of a woman in various professional poses and numerous social media icons (Facebook, Line, YouTube). Large, bold Chinese characters are displayed throughout, along with a green WhatsApp contact bar at the bottom.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Professional studio-quality Buddhist mantra chanting begins immediately. The primary male vocal is rhythmic, using a repetitive melodic contour with moderate pitch variability. A distinct high-frequency ceremonial bell 'ding' punctuates the start of each bar. The BGM consists of a steady electronic percussion track at approximately 105 BPM. (2) The chanting layer is joined by secondary background voices, creating a harmonious group texture. The acoustic brightness is high, focusing on the clarity of the vocal phonemes and the sharp transient of the bell. (3) Transition to the outdoor environment introduces subtle broadband crackling noises from a large fire, though the chanting remains the dominant signal with a high signal-to-noise ratio. (4) The audio track persists as a continuous loop through the graphic informational screens, maintaining the same rhythmic intensity and spiritual tone until the video ends.
